claims.speaker: the graph says
claims.text: Every path from program entry to the serial check {gate} crosses exactly one function: {passage}. It carries the highest betweenness in the call graph, which is why the constellation draws it gold.

claims.speaker: disasm says
claims.text: {anti_count} functions touch anti-analysis machinery: the constructor calls ptrace(TRACEME), and the checker scans its own bytes for the 0xCC software-breakpoint marker. Both wear a hot roof in the city.

claims.speaker: the lattice says
claims.text: Formal concept analysis over functions x imported capabilities recovers the binary's intent without running it: an anti-debug concept, a parse concept (strtoul), a string/crypto concept and an I/O concept.
